title: Product Risk
description: Schema for a product risk (PRISK-NNN) documented by Agente01_ProductOwner

description.description: What could go wrong — specific, not vague

trigger.description: Condition that would cause this risk to materialize

impact.description: Severity of impact if the risk materializes

impact_description.description: What specifically happens if this risk materializes

risk_score.description: Overall risk score derived from impact × likelihood

mitigation.description: Action to reduce likelihood or impact of the risk

contingency.description: What to do if the risk materializes despite mitigation

owner.description: Who is responsible for monitoring and mitigating this risk

escalate_to_tech_lead.description: True if this risk requires Tech Lead awareness or action
